name: Glow of Venus
source:
Less than a year before graduation, the protagonist has to change schools, because his parents changed jobs to a town hundreds of miles from his old school and didn't want to rent him a flat at their old town.

Forced into a new school with no friends and closed circles hard to get into, one day he finds an anonymous note in his shoe locker, asking him to meet them in a classroom after school.

Halfway expecting someone to play a prank on him or a school gang aiming to rough him up and extort him for money, he still anxiously makes his way to the specified room...

[From Itch.io]
translation:
距离毕业还不到一年，主角却不得不转学。父母换了工作，搬到离原来的学校数百英里的另一座城镇，又不愿在旧居所在的城镇为他租房。

他被迫进入一所陌生的学校，既没有朋友，也很难融入早已形成的小圈子。某天，他在鞋柜里发现一张匿名纸条，约他放学后去某间教室见面。

他有些怀疑这是恶作剧，或是校内的不良团伙打算揍他一顿、勒索钱财，但还是忐忑不安地走向了指定的教室……

[摘自Itch.io]
